data.name: Boston Step on Guide Service
data.headline: Starting: $325! |2-8 Hours| Our local expert guides will join you on your Boston experience!
data.description:
#Highlights
* Our local guide will join your group as you traverse Boston's iconic sights!
* Immerse yourself in the city's rich heritage, uncovering stories from Fenway Park to Beacon Hill
* Tailored experience narratives cater to your interests, ensuring a personalized journey through your trip!

**Inclusions: Local Guide Services**
**Exclusions: Food, drink, admissions, and gratuity**

#Summary 
Embark on an unforgettable exploration of Boston with our Step-On tour services. Our expert guides bring the city's history and culture to life as you traverse through its iconic neighborhoods and landmarks. From the Freedom Trail's revolutionary tales to the vibrant pulse of Quincy Market, our guides offer a tailored experience, catering to your interests and curiosities. Dive into the rich heritage of the city, discovering the stories behind Fenway Park, the charm of Beacon Hill, and the legacy of Paul Revere's midnight ride. Join us for an immersive journey through the heart of Boston, where every step unveils a new chapter in this city's captivating narrative making your tour experience a unique one!!
data.cancellation_notes: Our tours run rain or shine.  We only cancel tours in the event of unsafe weather conditions.  Customers will receive a full refund in case we cancel due to unsafe weather conditions or other unforeseen circumstances. Customers who wish to cancel their tour will receive a full refund with more than 24 hours notice of cancellation. Cancellations within 24 hours of the tour start time will be charged the full price.
